name: internetless-reading-wiring-20261010
description: HUNTED-PAGE WIRING (Oct 10 2026): corpus v0.3.0 adds URL lookup; browser v5 adds hash->URL fallback so search results open stored full text. 129/11,365 pages wired immediately; audit found 0 hash overlap, 1.1% URL overlap. Re-crawl of remaining pages proposed, pending approval. Browserbase verified.
content:
{
  "mission": "HARZ Internetless Reading \u2014 hunted-page wiring (approved by Rabiu 'Go' Oct 10 00:50). AUDIT FIRST performed before build.",
  "audit_findings": "Search index: 11,365 docs, all with content_hash, snippets capped at 2,000 chars, no full text stored anywhere on this account. Corpus: 1,055,189 docs with full text. Hash overlap: 0. URL overlap: 129 of 11,365 (1.1%). 478 search docs are HARZ ecosystem pages. Corpus capacity: 7.17GB of 9.5GB cap used (cap policy honored).",
  "build": "corpus v0.3.0: /api/doc now resolves by id, content_hash OR url (additive; key-gated, gates unchanged). browser v5: /doc-data sid resolution chain is now content_hash -> URL fallback -> honest preview; corpus doc ref hash used for device storage when resolved by URL.",
  "verification": "Live: sid=14 (SEC Nigeria) -> hash miss -> URL hit -> FULL 1,666 chars; sid=0 -> honest 2,000-char PREVIEW; id=1055000 regression full 14,424 chars; gates 400/401/404 clean; corpus stats/export unchanged. Browserbase real-browser render: /doc?sid=14 opens as a search result would, LIVE badge, full text, saved on device, SW on. Screenshot-grade render verified.",
  "honest_labels": "Only the 129 URL-overlapping hunted pages become fully readable by this wiring. The remaining 11,236 hunted pages have no stored full text anywhere \u2014 making them readable requires re-crawling their URLs and ingesting into the corpus (decision presented to Rabiu, pending approval).",
  "pending_decision": "Re-crawl proposal: fetch all 11,365 hunted URLs, ingest full text into corpus (respecting 9.5GB cap, est. ~350MB), update search index content_hash to corpus hash so hash path resolves first. Dead/changed pages remain honest previews. Awaiting Rabiu's go."
